findings.claim: The published correction to T4-1's evidence says ibm-1997's only 'annual report to security holders' hit sits 'inside item 14', but in the pipeline's own output that text lies outside every item span, in the 15,205-char unattributed tail.
findings.evidence: tasks/TODO.md T4 row ('carries the term only in its exhibit index (item 14, raw line 931 ...)'), commit 24d203c message ('exhibit index (item 14, line 931)'), evals/adversarial/ibr-security-holders.json triage.note ('inside item 14 (raw line 931)'). Measured at HEAD on evals/fixtures/ibm-1997/filing.txt: the term occurs once at normalized offset 45796; item 14's span is [23948, 31727) (ends at the '8 <PAGE>' footer before signatures); no item span covers 45796, and the envelope's own warning reports '15,205 after the last'. Raw line 931 is correct; 'item 14' is not. The functional conclusion (the hit is not a pointer, no real fixture flips — confirmed by my 43-fixture old-vs-new sweep: only ibr-security-holders item 6 moves) is unaffected.
findings.repro: cd <worktree> && python3 -c "import sys,re;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.sec10k.extract import extract_items as e;r=e('evals/fixtures/ibm-1997/filing.txt');t=r['normalized_text'];m=re.search('(?i)annual report to security holders',t);print(m.start(),[(i['item'],i['start'],i['end']) for i in r['items'] if i['item']=='14'],[i['item'] for i in r['items'] if i.get('start') is not None and i['start']<=m.start()<i['end']])"  -> 45796 [('14', 23948, 31727)] []
findings.acceptance: The T4 row, commit/PR evidence and the case's triage note say where the hit actually is ('in the exhibit index after the last item span — unattributed tail, raw line 931'), or otherwise stop attributing it to item 14; no code change needed.
